svg.title: The microtask queue is drained completely between every macrotask
svg.desc: A call stack holding the main script beside two trays: an upper microtask tray of promise callbacks and a lower macrotask tray of setTimeout and click. A green arrow runs from the microtask tray to the stack; a red arrow from the macrotask tray straight to the stack is crossed out because microtasks are still pending. Four numbered steps describe the cycle, and a strip of seven chips gives the verified output order from sync-start through to setTimeout zero last.
svg.text: The microtask queue is drained completely between every macrotask
